 class Account {
 <<abstract>>
 #userId : String
 #email : String
 #passwordHash : String
 +login(credentials) : boolean
 +logout() : void
 }

 class Employee {
 -department : String
 -employeeId : String

 }

 class FacilityManager {
 -adminRole : String

 }

 class FloorMap {
 -floorId : String
 -capacity : int
 +getAvailableDesks(slot) : List~Desk~
 }

 class Desk {
 -deskId : String
 -status : DeskStatus
 +isAvailable(slot) : boolean
 }

 class Booking {
 -bookingId : String
 -qrToken : String
 -status : BookingStatus
 +checkIn(token) : boolean
 +cancel() : boolean
 }

 Account <|-- Employee
 Account <|-- FacilityManager
 FloorMap \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" Desk : contains
 Employee \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Booking : places
 Desk \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Booking : reserved_for",
